Meta.DatabaseDescription: Disposable test vault for KeeFetch favicon downloader. Contains only fake credentials and public URLs.

Group.Name: KeeFetch Test Database
Group.Notes: All credentials are fake. Safe to modify/delete.

Group.Name: 01 Happy Paths
Group.Notes: Ordinary HTTPS sites with recognizable favicons.

Group.Name: 02 URL Normalization
Group.Notes: Scheme-less, deep paths, query strings, ports and mixed URL forms.

Group.Name: 03 Android App URLs
Group.Notes: Known Android mappings plus one intentionally nonexistent package.

Group.Name: 04 REF & Edge Cases
Group.Notes: KeePass field references and malformed/missing URLs.

Group.Name: 05 Deduplication
Group.Notes: Multiple entries from the same domains; fetched icon payloads should be reused/deduplicated in the KeePass database.

Group.Name: 07 Existing Custom Icon
Group.Notes: Use with “skip entries that already have custom icons” enabled. The first entry already has a custom icon.

Group.Name: 08 Bulk / Concurrency
Group.Notes: Use “Download All Favicons” on this group to exercise concurrent fetches.
